newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar erases most losses by late close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar erases most losses by late close.

text.p: White sugar futures in London erased most losses by the late close on Thursday, boosted by a stronger performance on the New York raw sugar market late in the day.
Benchmark March 1997 futures finished just 20 cents lower at $309.00 a tonne after hitting a low of $307.20.
Volumes were paltry, with total turnover just 536 lots, the bulk of which were traded in the March contract. Traders said the market was still in a post-holiday lull.
The moves in London largely reflected those in New York, where mixed selling pressured the market early on before support was found encouraging a limited recovery.
March finished at 10.94 a pound, down 0.06 but well above the low of the day at 10.78.
In Paris March 1997 futures rose 10 cents to $309.00. Total turover was just 112 lots.
